verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog and search data API, not payments infrastructure for developers to monetize their own APIs. Its MPP support (channel3-docs-18) only lets agents pay Channel3 for its own API calls, and developer monetization here works through affiliate revenue share (channel3-docs-4). Neither gives developers HTTP 402 per-call billing for their own services, so this story's axis falls outside the product's category.
